name: Jesenji Tok
description: Ti si Brana. 12 nedelja pre zime, 6 parcela, 3 radne grupe nedeljno — planiraš koje radove staviš u koji prozor. Sezona se zatvara zimskom burom.

modules.src/main.js: Entry point, DOM game loop, phase transitions (planning→bura→score→prestige)
modules.src/config.js: Task windows, group costs, score values, rank thresholds, weather preset data, STORAGE_KEYS
modules.src/state.js: Game state shape, save/load localStorage, prestige persistence, assignTask/unassignTask
modules.src/input.js: Tap/click handler, card select/deselect, keyboard shortcuts (1-6, Esc), haptic feedback
modules.src/render.js: DOM render orchestrator: grid+cards+forecast bar+HUD+toasts coordinator
modules.src/ui.js: HUD and tooltip orchestrator: state→UI sync, ecosystem status, intro message
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio: glineni thud (assign), drveni click, error buzz, harmonika (score), jesen ambient, bura sounds
modules.src/share.js: Web Share API, clipboard fallback, html2canvas score card, Guncati/Kluboslavija brand share text
modules.src/systems/weather.js: Preset selekcija, forecast buffer generisanje, blok aplikacija, getEffectiveWindow
modules.src/systems/validation.js: Legalan assign check: rain block, group capacity, window alignment (warning ne block)
modules.src/systems/scoring.js: Score kalkulacija, ekosistem bonus (Micelij+Jezero+Kompost ×1.5), rang određivanje
modules.src/systems/conflict.js: Conflict detection, error state management, setErrorState/tickErrorState
modules.src/systems/prestige.js: Prestige entry condition (≥300p), 3 bonus opcije, state reset sa bonusom
modules.src/systems/achievements.js: 6 achievements: first_assign, ekosistem_bonus, savrsena_sezona, prestige_3, no_weather_block
modules.src/ui/grid.js: 6×12 DOM grid, cell states, weather headers, capacity indicators, triggerCellError
modules.src/ui/cards.js: Task card palette, selection highlight, assign slot, group cost badge, flashCardAssigned
modules.src/ui/tutorial.js: FTUE 3-korak overlay, localStorage flag, skip dugme
modules.src/ui/score-screen.js: Zimska bura week-by-week reveal, score counter animation, breakdown, rang, share
modules.src/ui/prestige-screen.js: 3 bonus opcije, confirm/cancel flow, current bonus display
modules.src/content/tasks.js: 6 task definicija: id, naziv, parcel_type, window_start/end, group_cost, base_score, emoji, tooltip_edu
modules.src/content/brana_dialogs.js: Brana komentari po rangu (4 teksta), weather komentari, achievement poruke, TASK_INFO edukativni tooltipovi
modules.src/content/brand_hooks.js: Guncati masterclass CTA, Kluboslavija event URL, share_text funkcija, SCORE_CTAS
modules.styles/theme.css: Tamna šuma paleta: bg #1a2415, surface #2d3d20, accent #8bc34a, amber #f5a623, sve CSS varijable
modules.styles/base.css: Layout, mobile-first, toast container, intro message, eco status, tooltip, buttons
modules.styles/game.css: Grid struktura, cell stanja, error shake, zimska bura animacija, bura-weeks scroll
modules.styles/ui.css: Task card dizajn, score screen, prestige screen, tutorial overlay
